cohort: The study included 1605 premature infants born in Maternity & Child Care Center of Qinhuangdao between January 2020 and June 2023.
finding: Male sex, cesarean section, and diabetes in pregnancy were identified as risk factors for respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) and poor prognosis in premature infants, while premature rupture of membranes was a protective factor.
mod_finding: Cesarean section was identified as a risk factor for both respiratory distress syndrome (RDS) and poor prognosis in preterm infants.
